scripts.dev: concurrently --names host,frontend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta --kill-others "npm --prefix host-server run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently --names host,frontend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta --kill-others "npm run start --workspace ui" "npm --prefix host-server run start"
scripts.typecheck: concurrently --names host,frontend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run typecheck --workspace host-server" "npm run typecheck --workspace ui"
scripts.lint: concurrently --names host,frontend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run lint --workspace host-server" "npm run lint --workspace ui"
